correctness.rationale: The exact crossed-facet indicator laws for both \(1<c<2\) and \(2<c<3\) are derived from the actual vertices and tested independently against edge-crossing counts for nine parameter values. Their limit at \(c=2\) is an all-generic octagon. The exact quadrilateral event is six spherical right-cones, each split into four triangles and evaluated with the standard determinant solid-angle formula; its cube endpoint is verified. Four analytically evaluated interface-strip integrals multiplied by Haar chamber density \(12/\pi\) give all first-order coefficients, with overlapping corner areas \(O(arepsilon^2)\). The standalone checker, run from the new package path, agrees; finite checks are explicitly not treated as infinite proof.
